# Agreed terms: Larkspur Ceramics

Frozen on 5 January 2027 from `plans/larkspur-ceramics/contract-inputs.md` and the client part of `plans/larkspur-ceramics/quote.md`, each quoted exactly.

## Included
| # | Work package | Includes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Purchase orders from email into the order sheet | Error handling and alerts, run logs, acceptance tests, operator notes |
| 2 | An exceptions list for codes that match nothing | Acceptance tests and operator notes |
| 3 | An order confirmation view for the operations team | Error handling and alerts, run logs, acceptance tests, operator notes |
| 4 | A one-off clean-up of the existing product codes | Acceptance tests |
| 5 | Orders from the sheet into QuickBooks Online | Error handling and alerts, run logs, acceptance tests, operator notes |

## Ownership
The work is yours: it lives in your own repository and accounts, under your name, with your data. You receive the documentation and the tests with it, and the build's hosting account is opened in your name.

## User acceptance testing
Size M: 3 tester roles (order coordinator, operations manager, bookkeeper); the order coordinator checks WP-1, WP-2 and WP-4, the operations manager WP-3 and the bookkeeper WP-5; 3 sessions including the final confirmation run; up to 2 fix rounds within 5 business days each. USD 2,250.00, inside the fixed price.

## Acceptance and delivery
The build is accepted when you sign off user acceptance testing with every acceptance check passing, or as the contract's deemed-acceptance clause provides.

## Contract clauses
Contract clauses: not set.
